name: mla_multi_pass_q_amortize_kv
description: Process multiple Q head batches (Q_PASSES) per KV tile load to amortize KV memory traffic
steps: Set Q_PASSES = nhead / MFMA_HEADS (e.g., 128/16 = 8, but 2 is practical limit per block)
Load KV tile once into LDS (BLOCK_N × QK_HEAD_DIM)
Loop Q_PASSES times: load Q batch from global, compute QK MFMA, accumulate PV
Each pass processes MFMA_HEADS heads against the shared KV tile
Trade-off: more passes = better KV reuse but more VGPR for accumulators
expected_impact: 2-4x reduction in KV HBM traffic for GQA ratios ≥ 16
